paths.label: Lifter
paths.tagline: reps focus. push, squat, pull, burpee.

paths.label: Generalist
paths.tagline: jack of all trades. small bonus across the board.

bosses.name: The Intern
bosses.tagline: it's day 3 and they have 47 ideas for how to fix everything.
hits: wait — should i be taking notes on this?
is this billable to my onboarding hours?
let me circle back with my mentor real quick
bosses.defeated: intern slacks the whole team: 'i think i broke something. lol. help?'

bosses.name: The Caesarian
bosses.tagline: would do literally anything to avoid labour.
hits: i'm not really a 'reps person'
i scheduled a personal day during this fight
could we get an intern to do this part
bosses.defeated: caesarian books PTO retroactively and disappears for 2 weeks.

bosses.name: The Vibe Coder
bosses.tagline: claims to vibe-code. cursor does it. takes the credit anyway.
hits: hold on, my agent is generating a counterattack
tab tab tab tab tab tab
i'll have my AI respond to that move
bosses.defeated: vibe coder pushes a final commit. it doesn't compile. they go on vacation.

bosses.name: The Micromanager
bosses.tagline: tiny, bespectacled, hovers six inches off your shoulder.
hits: are those reps in your weekly plan?
i'm going to need to see the form on that
did you log this in the spreadsheet yet?
bosses.defeated: schedules a post-mortem for their own defeat. invites you. mandatory.

bosses.name: The Email Apologist
bosses.tagline: as i mentioned in my previous email…
hits: as i mentioned in my previous email
looping in stakeholders +chris +amy +leadership
per my last note re: this thread
bosses.defeated: sends one final 1,200-word recap email. nobody reads it. it haunts the inbox.

bosses.name: The Reply-All Reaper
bosses.tagline: to: everyone-everywhere — subject: re: re: re: re: who took the leftover pizza?
hits: +leadership for visibility
REPLY ALL: please remove me from this thread
FYI not actionable but adding the whole team
bosses.defeated: vanishes into a 47-person email thread. some say they're still typing.

bosses.name: The Bottleneck
bosses.tagline: every decision routes through them. they review on sundays.
hits: i'll review on sunday
let me think on it over the long weekend
i'm a bit underwater this sprint
bosses.defeated: bottleneck approves the PR. it's a typo fix from 2024.

bosses.name: The Thought Leader
bosses.tagline: daily linkedin essays. all about resilience. they fired everyone.
hits: mind if i share this on linkedin?
this is actually content for my newsletter
great learning moment for the team — thread incoming 🧵
bosses.defeated: publishes a 14-tweet retrospective. 3 likes. all from interns.

bosses.name: The HIPPO
bosses.tagline: Highest Paid Person's Opinion. always has the final word. always wrong.
hits: i don't agree but i don't have data either
let's go with my gut on this one
i was VP at uber in 2014. trust me.
bosses.defeated: HIPPO drops a 47-slide deck called 'thoughts' and quietly retires to a board seat.

bosses.name: The Re-Orgmancer
bosses.tagline: solves all problems with another re-org. now you report to mark.
hits: let's reshuffle the structure
you now report to mark, dotted-line to dual-track
we're forming a new pod. you're not on it. you're not not on it either.
bosses.defeated: re-orgmancer gets re-orged. you now report to nobody. you are free.

bosses.name: The Pivoteer
bosses.tagline: rebuilds the codebase. for the third time. calls it innovation.
hits: AI changes everything — pivot
we're more of a [insert new category] company now
let's just rebuild it from scratch this time
bosses.defeated: pivoteer announces another pivot in their goodbye email. they're starting an agency.

bosses.name: The Visionary
bosses.tagline: never coded. never sold. has been at every all-hands. has a vision.
hits: i have a vision
the future is [vague]
we're not just a product. we're a movement.
have you read 'zero to one'? we should reread it.
bosses.defeated: visionary boards a private jet to keynote a conference about how YOU defeated THEM. they call it growth.
